meta.description: Optional template metadata for display and discovery.

name.description: Human-readable template name for catalogs and editors.

description.description: Short human-readable template summary for catalogs and agents.

creativeDirection.description: Authoring brief (1..4000 characters): audience, visual hierarchy, typography, palette, motion, pacing, avoidances and review criteria. Guides humans/agents; never interpreted or executed by the renderer. Implement the direction explicitly in sections, filters and effect props.

allowNondeterministic.description: Opt out of the nondeterministic_expression check (wall-clock `%{localtime}`/`time(0)` or unseeded `random()` in raw filters). Default false: such templates fail validation.

global.description: Template-wide defaults: variables, orientation, audio, transitions, and music.

variables.description: Template-wide variable definitions referenced via {{ varName }} syntax.

orientation.description: Output video orientation; controls the resolution preset — landscape 1280x720, portrait 720x1280, square 1080x1080 (default: landscape).

platform.description: Delivery platform the video is made for: tiktok, reels (aliases ig, instagram), shorts (aliases yt-shorts, youtube-shorts), youtube, x (alias twitter), linkedin, facebook or square-feed. Sets the default orientation when global.orientation is omitted (portrait for tiktok/reels/shorts, square for square-feed, landscape otherwise); validation then warns about text under the app UI (per-edge safe zones, e.g. the bottom 22% under TikTok captions), a timeline longer than the platform accepts and an unusual fps; the default caption position is lifted clear of the bottom UI; and loudnorm targets the platform loudness (-14 LUFS, -1 dBTP). Rendering is otherwise unchanged.

seed.description: Root seed (uint32, default 0) for every procedural effect: each element derives its own stream as hash(seed, element path), so the same seed always renders the same shake, grain and scramble.

energy.description: Global motion intensity (0..1.5, default 1): scales every reveal/exit/overlay travel distance and relative keyframe offset. 0 is a reduced-motion cut (fades only).

stiffness.description: Spring stiffness k (1..2000). Higher is snappier.

mass.description: Mass m (0.1..20, default 1). Heavier is slower.

velocity.description: Initial velocity toward the target, in distances per second (default 0).

additionalProperties.description: A physical spring; its duration is derived (time to settle within 0.1%) unless one is authored.

durations.description: Named durations in seconds, referenced from keyframe times as "$name" or "+$name".

motion.description: Motion tokens: one design system for time, shared by every animated field.

fps.description: Output frame rate for the rendered video (integer 1..120, default 30).

colorsList.description: Palette of colours offered to the user for customisation, as CSS hex strings.

musicEnabled.description: Whether background music is enabled for this template (default true).

transition.description: Default transition applied between sections when no per-section transition is set.

type.description: xfade transition name between this section and the next, "cut" for a hard cut, or a designed transition: push-left/right/up/down, swipe-left/right, zoom-through, iris.

ease.description: Curve of a designed transition (default cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)); springs overshoot.

duration.description: Transition length in seconds (default: the global transition duration, then 0.3).

audio.description: Global audio mix settings (volumes, normalisation, ducking).

sourceVolume.description: Volume of the recorded/source audio in the final mix, 0..1 (default 1).

musicVolume.description: Volume of the background music track in the final mix, 0..1 (default 0.5).

normalize.description: FFmpeg audio normalisation filter to apply to the final mix (default: none).

ducking.description: Enable music ducking when source audio is present; true uses defaults, object allows fine-tuning.

threshold.description: Audio level (0..1) below which music ducking activates (default 0.05).

ratio.description: Compression ratio applied when ducking is active, 1..20 (default 8).

anyOf.description: Fine-grained ducking parameters; used when global.audio.ducking is an object instead of a boolean.

musicFade.description: Length in seconds of the music cross-fade between sections, independent of the video transition (default: the global transition duration). Longer values smooth large per-section musicVolume changes.

music.description: Default background music track for the template.

name.description: Human-readable name of the music track.

url.description: URL of the music file; omit to use an app-managed track.

animations.description: Whole-video animation overlays composited over the final joined video, spanning all sections.

url.description: URL or file path of the overlay — an animated single-file format (.apng/.webp/.gif/.webm), stream-looped, or a still raster image (.png/.jpg/.jpeg), held with -loop 1 for the whole video; may use {{ varName }}.

position.description: Overlay position as "x:y" in output pixels (e.g. "0:0" top-left).

scale.description: Scale expression applied to the overlay before compositing, as "w:h".

fit.description: How the overlay maps into its "w:h" scale box: "stretch" (default) scales freely and may distort; "contain" letterboxes inside the box with transparent padding; "cover" fills the box and centre-crops the overflow. Ignored without a fixed positive "w:h" scale.

opacity.description: Overlay alpha from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque); 1 (or omitted) keeps it fully opaque.

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees applied to the overlay before compositing.

flip.description: Mirror the overlay before compositing: "horizontal" flips left-right, "vertical" flips top-bottom, "both" applies both.

loop.description: When true, the overlay loops continuously for the whole video duration (default false).

loops.description: Number of times the overlay plays (finite). Takes precedence over loop; omit for loop/once.

duration.description: Seconds the overlay plays before it ends (loops the source to fill). Takes precedence over loops/loop.

start.description: Seconds to delay the overlay before it appears (via -itsoffset); 0/omitted starts at the beginning.

persistent.description: When true, the overlay freezes its last frame once it ends instead of letting the video show through.

motion.description: Animated entrance for the overlay: rise/slide in via overlay x/y expressions, or an alpha fade-in on the overlay leg.

type.description: Entrance style: none, fade, rise (up from below), slide-left, slide-right.

distance.description: Pixels the text travels for rise/slide (default 60).

easing.description: Progress curve for the entrance (default linear). ease-out decelerates; ease-in-out ramps up and settles; ease-out-back overshoots travel by about 10% and settles, with text alpha clamped to 0..1. Also springs (duration derived when omitted), cubic-bezier, the named curves and $tokens. Ignored by an overlay fade motion (the fade filter is linear only).

outline.description: Outline/border: true for a 2px black outline, or an object to customise colour/width.

caret.description: typewriter: draw a blinking caret (default true).

amplitude.description: wave: bob height in px (default 6% of size).

charset.description: scramble: characters to decode from (default A-Z0-9 and #%&*).

counter.description: counter preset: the rolling number (text is ignored).

from.description: Start value (non-negative; use prefix "-" for negatives).

suffix.description: Text after the number, e.g. "%" or "K".

exit.description: How the block leaves: a preset name or an object (default none: holds to the cut).

preset.description: How the block leaves (default fade). cascade = staggered rise-out.

at.description: When the exit begins: seconds from the section start or a time reference ("end - 0.6"); default: ends with the section.

duration.description: Seconds each unit takes to leave (default 0.35).

stagger.description: Seconds between units leaving (default: entrance stagger / 2).

ease.description: Exit curve (default ease-in-cubic).

distance.description: Travel in px for rise/drop/slide/cascade exits.

anyOf.description: Exit choreography for a kinetic block.

KineticBlock.description: Kinetic typography block: per-word / per-glyph choreography, laid out and wrapped automatically.

preset.description: Camera move. push-in / pull-out: slow dolly toward / away. drift-*: lateral or vertical glide. orbit: push with a curved drift. handheld: organic seeded shake only. none: hits/shake/tracks only (default).

amount.description: Move strength: zoom delta and drift range (default 0.12).

delay.description: When the preset move starts: seconds (default 0) or a time reference.

duration.description: Seconds the preset move takes (default: to the section end).

ease.description: Curve of the preset move (default ease-in-out-sine).

zoom.description: Zoom keyframes (1 = framed, 1.2 = 20% closer); overrides the preset zoom.

t.description: When this key is reached: seconds from the section start (1.2), relative to the previous key ("+0.3"), a duration token ("$base", "+$short"), or a time reference ("title.end + 0.2", "beat:8 - 0.1", "50%", "end - 0.5", "cue:drop"). Omitted: the previous key plus this ease's natural duration (a spring settles on its own) or 0.6 s; the first key defaults to 0.

v.description: Value at this key. x/y: pixels, or "+80"/"-40" relative to the resting position (scaled by energy). opacity: 0..1. scale: a multiplier of the font size.

ease.description: Curve INTO this key from the previous one (default linear).

x.description: Camera x keyframes in output px (+ moves the camera right); overrides the preset.

hits.description: Punch-ins on beats: seconds, a time reference ("beat:8"), or { at, strength, decay }. Pair with kinetic impact or a flash.

at.description: When the punch lands: seconds from the section start or a time reference ("beat:8", "title.end").

decay.description: How fast the punch relaxes, per second (default 10).

shake.description: Seeded organic shake (sum of sines; global.seed reshuffles it).

includeText.description: Move text and graphics with the frame (default true); false keeps overlays steady over a moving shot.

ease.description: Curve of the animation (default per type, e.g. $expo).

until.description: When it disappears: seconds or a time reference ("end - 0.3"); default: holds to the cut.
